## What This Agent Should Never Do

- Never change permits, assignments, inspections or fees, or send applicant messages. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md)
- Never certify compliance or mark an unchecked review as passed or waived. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/skills/aibast_review-checklist_bp05/SKILL.md)
- Never replace the fixed synthetic snapshot with invented records or current-date facts. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md)
- Never publish the workshop or manufacture an inspector-skill validation failure. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/README.md)
